The testbench does all reference-model arithmetic in 32-bit integers, so it stays width-clean if Verilator compiles it with default (fatal) warnings. The main remaining risks: Verilator may flag the integer-indexed wait-counter array (a loop index), Icarus may need SystemVerilog mode for $error, and $error may stop Verilator at the first failure. A stop at the first failure still makes the run fail, as it should. Follow-up work outside this task: rr_arbiter_tb_fail.v, and the SymbiYosys proofs at N=4 and N=5 including the wait-counter fairness invariant.
